resources.string: Takes the power and TV keys from the phone\'s Bluetooth remote and puts the box into or out of standby (screen and HDMI off, TV asleep over CEC).
Remote standby and wake for webpad\'s N1 firmware. Opening this screen sets everything up.
Unreachable: network ADB is off, or a computer is holding the box\'s ADB right now
Enabled, starting… press Set up again in a moment

Not set: the power key would really shut the box down
Remote keys (Phicomm original, Xiaomi and other Bluetooth remotes)

Left as is (Phicomm power shuts down, power on other remotes does nothing)
